text: For some reason, you want to return all things ordered. You have two payment methods and two orders, and you want to refund each order to the other order's payment method. If not possible, you are angry and swear for a few times, then agree to return all things with the original payment method.
zh: 不知为何，您想退掉所有订购的东西。您有两种支付方式，两个订单，想把每个订单退到另一个订单的支付方式。如果不行，您会生气并骂几句，然后同意用原支付方式退掉所有东西 (#W1234567)。
